meta.cite: Barton O. Oliver's mTOR Atlas. doi:10.5281/zenodo.22059963

data.mechanism: PIP3 made by PI3K binds SIN1 and releases its hold on the kinase site - so growth-factor signalling switches mTORC2 on, not only mTORC1.
data.mechanism_beginner: The same lipid signal that switches Akt on also switches mTORC2 on – so growth-factor signals hit both complexes.
data.boundary: Growth-factor dependence of mTORC2 assembly and activity, shown in mammalian cells. The ribosome requirement (ZIN2011) means the readout is not a clean separation of PI3K input from translational state.
data.note: Drawn as canonical because four independent studies in this corpus support it; the open part is how much of the effect is PI3K input versus ribosome association.
